status_at_creation: Prespecified before fresh data generation and before fitting
purpose: Test whether seven explicitly simulated questionnaire-range and sleep-history features change next-day custom-fatigue classification under a controlled fresh synthetic scenario.
not_a_claim: No measured astronaut data or actual questionnaire responses are available.
No NASA-validated equations, clinical accuracy, real-instrument improvement or operational fitness is established.
No assumption or noise parameter may be tuned to obtain a higher model score.
New-cohort scores cannot be compared directly with the original model's historical 0.5273 validation Macro-F1.
preserve: Existing Python/TypeScript APIs and current 26-feature contract
Experiments 001 through 005 and all historical evaluation records

compute.location: Current managed /workspace execution environment, not the user's laptop

cohort.target_rule: Next-day custom synthetic self_report_fatigue_score: low<4; moderate>=4 and<7; high>=7. Original state-evolution process retained.
cohort.invalid_generation_policy: Abort and document the inconsistency before any training; never delete rows or silently adjust original labels.

questionnaire_definition.notation: F is CURRENT unrounded simulated latent fatigue; N(mean,sd) denotes a fresh independent normal draw. Latent states are simulation machinery only, never model predictors.
questionnaire_definition.kss_like_output: Ordinal 1..9 by threshold bin; not a validated KSS response simulation or a rescaled observed fatigue score.
questionnaire_definition.sp_like_output: Ordinal 1..7 by threshold bin; not a validated Samn-Perelli response simulation.

sleep_definition.main_sleep: Allocate hypothetical sleep/wake episodes consistent with the base simulator's TST, efficiency, onset delay, awakening count and signed midpoint deviation. Check all interval and arithmetic invariants.
sleep_definition.planned_midpoint: 04:00 UTC; actual onset/final-awakening midpoint shifted by saved circadian-deviation minutes.
sleep_definition.waso: Allocate synthetic awake residual into WASO and terminal waking. Zero WASO if zero awakenings; otherwise at least3minutes per awakening. This is an allocation assumption, not recovery of measured WASO.
sleep_definition.nap: At most1 optional nap per day. Independent Bernoulli0.25; proposed duration Uniform(10,40)minutes, bounded by unused daily budget and a nonoverlapping pre-cutoff window. Zero if infeasible. No nap latency or within-nap awakenings modeled.
sleep_definition.total_sleep: Sleep-interval intersection with the 24hours before assessment, including the simulated nap without double counting.
sleep_definition.time_awake: Hours since the end of the most recent sleep episode, including naps.
sleep_definition.goal: Explicit configured8hour target; metadata rather than hidden biological sleep need.
sleep_definition.prior_shortfall: Sum max(0,8-total_sleep) over the three preceding nonoverlapping daily windows only.
sleep_definition.limitation: Original fatigue evolution remains based on original main-sleep inputs. New naps have no modeled restorative effect. Derived timing features often re-express information already in the baseline.

deferred: Actual KSS or Samn-Perelli administration and validated language versions
Actual timed PVT/PVT-B or false-start measurement; existing60-response >=500ms simulation remains
Caffeine, acute symptoms, medication and recent-exercise causal effects without new data or a separately justified model
Actual attention-task implementation and sensor/ECG validation

sequence: freeze selected extension and fitted artifacts
development.primary_control: Original-recipe RF with26features, fitted on the fresh training cohort
development.secondary_pair: XGBoost26 versus XGBoost26+all7; not used to change the primary control
development.selection: 3fixed participant-disjoint folds inside84training people. Select RF extension using mean Macro-F1, rounded6decimals; ties prefer fewer features then candidate name. No hyperparameter search.
development.preprocessing: Any learned imputation is fitted inside each fitting fold. IDs, targets, timestamps, raw internal states and future outcomes are excluded from predictors.
development.holdouts: Validation and test keep every assigned participant and row. Choices are frozen before either outcome set is scored; no follow-up tuning on holdout results.
development.exploratory_signal_rule: Primary selected-extension test gain >=0.01Macro-F1, positive lower bootstrap bound and High-class recall loss <=0.02; report rather than use as deployment approval.
development.promotion: Never automatic. Existing serving model remains selected regardless of synthetic experiment scores.
